head_commit.message:
Preserve the async Guardian history prefix as retained context changes (#49993)

## Why

The rolling retained-context window can change as assistant messages are added or evicted. Placing it before the transcript invalidates the reusable history prefix.

## What changed

Move retained user instructions and context after the transcript and action-specific attestations, immediately before the planned action in asynchronous Guardian requests. Keep synchronous section ordering unchanged.

## Testing

Extend the cache-prefix regression test to cover retained assistant message growth and eviction alongside changing attestations. Update app-server and async scorer assertions to verify the new request ordering.

## Why

The rolling retained-context window can change as assistant messages are added or evicted. Placing it before the transcript invalidates the reusable history prefix.

## What changed

Move retained user instructions and context after the transcript and action-specific attestations, immediately before the planned action in asynchronous Guardian requests. Keep synchronous section ordering unchanged.

## Testing

Extend the cache-prefix regression test to cover retained assistant message growth and eviction alongside changing attestations. Update app-server and async scorer assertions to verify the new request ordering.

head_commit.message:
Preserve the async Guardian history prefix as retained context changes (#49993)

## Why

The rolling retained-context window can change as assistant messages are added or evicted. Placing it before the transcript invalidates the reusable history prefix.

## What changed

Move retained user instructions and context after the transcript and action-specific attestations, immediately before the planned action in asynchronous Guardian requests. Keep synchronous section ordering unchanged.

## Testing

Extend the cache-prefix regression test to cover retained assistant message growth and eviction alongside changing attestations. Update app-server and async scorer assertions to verify the new request ordering.
